source_description_html:
Forcefield Contakt Shorts

The Forcefield Contakt Shorts are a specifically designed 8 panel riding short that features both CE approved armor and a 3D Coolmax Silver anti-bacterial chamois pad for maximum protection and comfort. Fitted with FLHex Armor from the Nitrex Evo family, the removable fully CE approved armor is just 9mm thick and boasts incredible multi directional flexibility and a super malleable compound which allows the armor to contour around the riders shape and flow with the movement of the body resulting in the most dynamic and comfortable armored riding shorts available today.

The silky soft integrated 3D CoolMax Silver anti-bacterial chamois pad is fitted for both comfort and hygiene. The seamless construction and 4–way stretch give unparalleled comfort while the Silver-based bacteriostatic additive manages moisture and neutralizes odor causing bacteria. Designed to be so comfortable you will forget you are wearing them, the Contakt Shorts are ideal whether you are riding all day or just going for a fast blast around your local trail or track.

Features:

  • Nitrex Evo FLHex CE Armor
  • 8 Panel Design
  • 3D CoolMax Silver anti-bacterial chamois pad
  • Removable and modular armor
  • High quality silicone leg grippers
  • RPT (Repeat Performance Technology)
  • Ergonomically designed
  • Machine washable (with armor removed)
